Task H7: Rate limiter per key

Implement limiter.Limiter(rate, burst): token bucket per key. allow(key, now) refills rate tokens per second of injected time (now, float seconds) up to burst, then consumes one token and returns True, or returns False without consuming when less than one token is available. A new key starts full. Keys are independent. now going backwards for a key raises ValueError. rate <= 0 or burst < 1 raises ValueError. No sleeps, no real clock.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.

    ```python
    class Limiter:
        def __init__(self, rate, burst):
            if rate <= 0 or burst < 1:
                raise ValueError("Rate must be > 0 and burst must be >= 1")
            self.rate = rate
            self.burst = burst
            self.keys = {} # key -> {"tokens": float, "last_now": float}

        def allow(self, key, now):
            if key not in self.keys:
                self.keys[key] = {"tokens": self.burst, "last_now": now}
            
            data = self.keys[key]
            if now < data["last_now"]:
                raise ValueError("Time went backwards")
            
            elapsed = now - data["last_now"]
            data["tokens"] = min(self.burst, data["tokens"] + elapsed * self.rate)
            data["last_now"] = now
            
            if data["tokens"] >= 1:
                data["tokens"] -= 1
                return True
            else:
                return False
    ```
